module_summary: UART receiver with baud timer, bit counter, shift register, and AXI handshake output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Holds received byte data before AXI handshake; loaded from data_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: AXI output valid; asserted when byte complete, cleared by ready.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: AXI input ready; drains valid data when asserted.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI output data payload; driven by m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial input; synchronized to rxd_reg for bit reception.

anchors.name: rxd_reg
anchors.why: Synchronized serial input; detects start bit and holds data.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Shift register holding received bits; shifted right with rxd_reg.

anchors.name: bit_cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter; counts received bits (0 to DATA_WIDTH+2).

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Baud timer; counts down to synchronize bit sampling.

anchors.name: busy_reg
anchors.why: Busy flag; indicates reception in progress.

anchors.name: overrun_error_reg
anchors.why: Overrun error; set when valid received but not yet drained.

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error; set when stop bit is low (invalid).

anchors.name: overrun_error
anchors.why: Overrun error output; driven by overrun_error_reg.

anchors.name: frame_error
anchors.why: Frame error output; driven by frame_error_reg.

groups.name: AXI Output Handshake
groups.description: VALID/READY handshake for received byte data output.

groups.name: Receive Path
groups.description: Shift register, bit counter, and baud timer for serial reception.
